definitions.explanation: When followed by a negative verb, means 'not in any place' or 'not to any place.' This is the most common usage.
When followed by a positive verb, means 'in/to every place without exception.' Less common than the negative usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どこにも⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The key is nowhere to be found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこにも⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、どこにも⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I searched, but I couldn't find it anywhere.

examples.japanese: どこにも{逃|に}げ{場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no place to escape to.

examples.japanese: どこにも⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこにも⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧ (where) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (location particle) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even/also). The meaning changes based on whether the verb is negative or affirmative:
- Negative verb → nowhere: どこにも⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not anywhere)
- Affirmative verb → everywhere: どこにも⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (everywhere)

The negative pattern is far more common in everyday speech.

Note the difference from ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (somewhere), which uses ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ instead of ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どこにも⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not found anywhere; nowhere
- どこにも⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧: not going anywhere
- どこにも⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: can't be found anywhere
- どこにも⟦{売|う}っていない→売る：00906_uru⟧: not sold anywhere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: somewhere — indefinite location (with ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ instead of ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧)
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: nowhere/everywhere (directional) — uses the directional particle ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧ instead of ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: anywhere; wherever — focuses on the place where an action occurs, without restriction
